description: Show what wrote an entity and when: the operations that touched it, newest first, with their timestamp, node and kind. Use it to tell a fact confirmed yesterday from one nobody has touched in months, which no other tool answers — read_conflicts covers only contested elements, and the graph itself carries no dates. For the current state use open_nodes; for what changed in a window use read_changes.

entityNames.description: The entities to trace; a relation counts under both of its endpoints

limit.description: The most operations to return, 50 by default and at most 500

offset.description: How many operations to skip before the page; omit for none

name: read_history
title: Read History
